newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Belgian, British and Irish towns win beauty prize.
newsitem.headline: Belgian, British and Irish towns win beauty prize.

text.p: Europe's three most beautiful towns are in Belgium, Britain and Ireland, an international jury decided on Saturday.

The Belgian town of Malmedy, Barnstaple in the west of England and Skerries, on Ireland's east coast, each won a golden award at the European competition of towns and villages in bloom, held in Eger, north-eastern Hungary, a former winner of the annual contest.
"I am absolutely thrilled. We have all worked very hard," the head of Barnstaple's district council, Faye Webber, told Reuters as she hugged the prize -- a bronze plate decorated with golden flowers.
Nine European countries took part in the competition which was held in Eger's 18th century baroque and was attended by approximately 300 guests.
